Value Proposition: VisionIQ delivers real-time shelf monitoring for retailers. Optimizing it on Intel hardware lowers per-store inference cost, removes the GPU dependency at the edge, and lets Acme scale to thousands of stores with CPU-only deployments while keeping latency under 50 ms per frame.
Intel Software Stack: OpenVINO 2025.x, oneDNN, Intel Extension for PyTorch
Model Optimizations: INT8 quantization (NNCF), operator fusion, async inference
Success Criteria: INT8 model meets accuracy target on Acme validation set
